- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- verify: Verify that a code change actually does what it's supposed to by running the app and observing behavior. Use when asked to verify a PR, confirm a fix works, test a change manually, check that a feature works, or validate local changes before pushing.
- code-review: Review the current diff for correctness bugs and reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups at the given effort level (low/medium: fewer, high-confidence findings; high→max: broader coverage, may include uncertain findings; ultra: deep multi-agent review in the cloud). Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review.
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.

- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").

First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).

1	From BV Require Import BVList InvCond.
2	Require Import List Bool NArith Psatz ZArith Nnat.
3	
4	Include RAW2BITVECTOR(RAWBITVECTOR_LIST).
5	
6	
7	(*------------------------------Neg------------------------------*)
8	(* -x = t <=> True *)
9	
10	Theorem bvneg_eq : forall (n : N), forall (t : bitvector n),
11	  iff 
12	    True 
13	    (exists (x : bitvector n), bv_eq (bv_neg x) t = true).
14	Proof.
15	  intros n t. unfold bv_eq, bv_neg in *.  cbn in *. split.
16	  + intros H. destruct t as (t, Ht). 
17	    specialize (bvneg_eq n t Ht); intros.
18	    destruct H0 as (Hltr, Hrtl).
19	    specialize (@Hltr H). destruct Hltr as (x, (Hx, Hltr)). 
20	    exists (@MkBitvector n x Hx). 
21	    now rewrite RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bv_eq_reflect. 
22	  + easy. 
23	Qed.
24	
25	(*------------------------------------------------------------*)
26	
27	
28	(*------------------------------Not------------------------------*)
29	(* ~x - t <=> True *)
30	Theorem bvnot_eq : forall (n : N), forall (t : bitvector n),
31	  iff
32	    True
33	    (exists (x : bitvector n), bv_eq (bv_not x) t = true).
34	Proof.
35	  intros n t. unfold bv_eq, bv_not in *. cbn in *. split. 
36	  + intros H. destruct t as (t, Ht).
37	    specialize (bvnot_eq n t Ht); intros.
38	    destruct H0 as (Hltr, Hrtl). specialize (@Hltr H).
39	    destruct Hltr as (x, (Hx, Hltr)).
40	    exists (@MkBitvector n x Hx).
41	    now rewrite RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bv_eq_reflect.
42	  + easy.
43	Qed.
44	
45	(*------------------------------------------------------------*)
46	
47	
48	(*------------------------------And------------------------------*)
49	(* t & s = t <=> (exists x, x & s = t) *)
50	Theorem bvand_eq : forall (n : N), forall (s t : bitvector n), 
51	  iff 
52	    (bv_eq (bv_and t s) t = true)
53	    (exists (x : bitvector n), bv_eq (bv_and x s) t = true).
54	Proof. intros.
55	       destruct s as (s, Hs).
56	       destruct t as (t, Ht).
57	       unfold bv_and, bv_eq, bv in *.
58	       specialize (bvand_eq n s t Hs Ht); intros.
59	       destruct H as (H, Ha).
60	       split; intros.
61	       + rewrite RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bv_eq_reflect in H0.
62	         specialize (H H0). 
63	         destruct H as (x, (Hx, p)).
64	         exists (@MkBitvector n x Hx).
65	         now rewrite RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bv_eq_reflect.
66	       + rewrite RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bv_eq_reflect. apply Ha.
67	         destruct H0 as ((x, Hx), p).
68	         rewrite RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bv_eq_reflect in p.
69	         exists x. split; easy.
70	Qed.
71	
72	
73	(* ~(-t) & s <s t <=> (exists x, x & s <s t) *)
74	Theorem bvand_slt : forall (n : N), forall (s t : bitvector n),
75	  iff
76	    ((bv_slt (bv_and (bv_not (bv_neg t)) s) t) = true) 
77	    (exists (x : bitvector n), (bv_slt (bv_and x s) t) = true).
78	Proof. intros.
79	       destruct s as (s, Hs).
80	       destruct t as (t, Ht).
81	       unfold bv_and, bv_slt, bv in *. cbn in *.
82	       specialize (bvand_slt n s t Hs Ht); intros.
83	       destruct H as (H, Ha).
84	       split; intros.
85	       + unfold bv_not in H0. specialize (H H0).
86	         destruct H as (x, (Hx, p)).
87	          exists (@MkBitvector n x Hx). apply p.
88	       + apply Ha. destruct H0 as ((x, Hx), H0).
89	         now exists x.
90	Qed.
91	
92	
93	(*------------------------------------------------------------*)
94	
95	
96	(*------------------------------Or------------------------------*)
97	(* t & s = t <=> (exists x, x | s = t) *)
98	Theorem bvor_eq : forall (n : N), forall (s t : bitvector n), 
99	   iff 
100	    (bv_eq (bv_or t s) t = true)
101	    (exists (x : bitvector n), bv_eq (bv_or x s) t = true).
102	Proof. intros.
103	       destruct s as (s, Hs).
104	       destruct t as (t, Ht).
105	       unfold bv_or, bv_eq, bv in *. cbn.
106	       specialize (bvor_eq n s t Hs Ht); intros.
107	       destruct H as (Ha, H).
108	       split; intros.
109	       + rewrite RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bv_eq_reflect in H0.
110	         specialize (Ha H0). 
111	         destruct Ha as (x, (Hx, p)).
112	         exists (@MkBitvector n x Hx).
113	         now rewrite RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bv_eq_reflect.
114	       + rewrite RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bv_eq_reflect. apply H.
115	         destruct H0 as ((x, Hx), p).
116	         rewrite RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bv_eq_reflect in p.
117	         exists x. split; easy.
118	Qed.
119	
120	(*------------------------------------------------------------*)
121	
122	
123	(*--------------------Logical left shift 1--------------------*)
124	(* (t >> s) << s = t <=> (exists x, x << s = t) *)
125	Theorem bvshl_eq : forall (n : N), forall (s t : bitvector n),
126	    iff
127	     (bv_eq (bv_shl (bv_shr t s) s) t = true)
128	     (exists (x : bitvector n), bv_eq (bv_shl x s) t = true).
129	Proof. intros.
130	       destruct s as (s, Hs).
131	       destruct t as (t, Ht).
132	       unfold bv_shl, bv_eq, bv in *. cbn.
133	       specialize (bvshl_eq n s t Hs Ht); intros.
134	       destruct H as (Ha, H).
135	       split; intros.
136	       + rewrite RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bv_eq_reflect in H0.
137	         specialize (Ha H0).
138	         destruct Ha as (x, (Hx, p)).
139	         exists (@MkBitvector n x Hx).
140	         now rewrite RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bv_eq_reflect.
141	       + rewrite RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bv_eq_reflect. apply H.
142	         destruct H0 as ((x, Hx), p).
143	         rewrite RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bv_eq_reflect in p.
144	         exists x. split; easy.
145	Qed.
146	
147	
148	(* t != 0 or s <u size(s) <=> (exists x, x << s != t) *)
149	Theorem bvshl_neq_ltr: forall (n : N), forall (s t : bitvector n), 
150	    bv_eq t (zeros n) = false \/ 
151	     bv_ult s (nat2bv (N.to_nat n) n) = true ->
152	    (exists (x : bitvector n), bv_eq (bv_shl x s) t = false).
153	Proof. intros.
154	       destruct s as (s, Hs).
155	       destruct t as (t, Ht).
156	       unfold bv_ult, bv_ashr_a, bv_eq, bv in *. cbn in *.
157	       specialize (bvshl_neq_ltr n s t Hs Ht); intros.
158	       rewrite Ht, Hs in H0. specialize (@H0 H).
159	       destruct H0 as (x, (Hx, H0)). now exists (@MkBitvector n x Hx). 
160	Qed.
161	
162	Theorem bvshl_neq_rtl: forall (n : N), forall (s t : bitvector n), 
163	    (exists (x : bitvector n), bv_eq (bv_shl x s) t = false) ->
164	    bv_eq t (zeros n) = false \/ 
165	    bv_ult s (nat2bv (N.to_nat n) n) = true.
166	Proof. intros.
167	       destruct s as (s, Hs).
168	       destruct t as (t, Ht).
169	       unfold bv_ult, bv_ashr_a, bv_eq, bv in *. cbn in *.
170	       specialize (bvshl_neq_rtl n s t Hs Ht); intros.
171	       rewrite Hs, Ht in H0. apply H0.
172	       destruct H as ((x, Hx), p).
173	       exists (@MkBitvector n x Hx). cbn in *.
174	       split. easy. apply p.
175	Qed.
176	
177	Theorem bvshl_neq: forall (n : N), forall (s t : bitvector n), 
178	  iff
179	    (bv_eq t (zeros n) = false \/ 
180	     bv_ult s (nat2bv (N.to_nat n) n) = true)
181	    (exists (x : bitvector n), bv_eq (bv_shl x s) t = false).
182	Proof.
183	  intros. split.
184	  + apply bvshl_neq_ltr.
185	  + apply bvshl_neq_rtl.
186	Qed.
187	
188	(* (t <u (~0 << s)) <=> (exists x, x << s >u t) *)
189	Theorem bvshl_ugt : forall (n : N), forall (s t : bitvector n),
190	  iff
191	    (bv_ult t (bv_shl (bv_not (zeros n)) s) = true)
192	    (exists (x : bitvector n), (bv_ugt (bv_shl x s) t = true)).
193	Proof. intros. 
194	        split; intros;
195	        destruct s as (s, Hs);
196	        destruct t as (t, Ht);
197	        unfold bv_ult, bv_ugt, bv_shl, zeros, bv_not, bits, bv in *;
198	        cbn in *;
199	        specialize (bvshl_ugt n s t Hs Ht); intros;
200	        unfold RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bv_not, RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bits in *;
201	        destruct H0 as (H0a, H0b).
202	        - rewrite Hs in H0a.
203	          specialize (H0a H).
204	          destruct H0a as (x, (Hx, p)).
205	          now exists (@MkBitvector n x Hx).
206	        - rewrite Hs in H0b.
207	          apply H0b.
208	          destruct H as ((x, Hx), p).
209	          exists x. split; easy.
210	Qed.
211	
212	(* ~0 << s >=u t <=> x << s >= t *)
213	Theorem bvshl_uge : forall (n : N), forall (s t : bitvector n), iff
214	    (bv_uge (bv_shl (bv_not (zeros n)) s) t = true)
215	    (exists (x : bitvector n), (bv_uge (bv_shl x s) t = true)).
216	Proof. intros. destruct s as (s, Hs).
217	       destruct t as (t, Ht).
218	       unfold bv_uge, bv_shl, zeros, bv_not, bits, bv in *.
219	       specialize (bvshl_uge n s t Hs Ht); intros.
220	       destruct H as (Hltr, Hrtl).
221	       split; intros.
222	       - rewrite Hs in Hltr. specialize (@Hltr H). destruct Hltr as (x, (Hx, Hltr)).
223	         exists (@MkBitvector n x Hx). apply Hltr.
224	       - destruct H as ((x, Hx), H). rewrite Hs in Hrtl. 
225	         apply Hrtl. exists x. now split. 
226	Qed.
227	
228	(* (s <u min(s) \/ t >= s) <=> s >>a x <= t *)
229	Theorem bvashr_ule2 : forall (n : N), forall (s t : bitvector n),
230	  iff
231	    ((bv_ult s (signed_min n) = true) \/ (bv_uge t s = true))
232	    (exists (x : bitvector n), bv_ule (bv_ashr s x) t = true).
233	Proof.
234	  intros n s t. destruct s as (s, Hs). destruct t as (t, Ht).
235	    unfold bv_ult, bv_uge, bv_ule, bv_ashr, signed_min in *.
236	    cbn in *. pose proof (@bvashr_ule2 n s t Hs Ht). 
237	    destruct H as (ltr, rtl). split.
238	  + intros H. specialize (@ltr H). destruct ltr as (x, (Hx, ltr)).
239	    exists (@MkBitvector n x Hx). easy.
240	  + intros H. destruct H as ((x, Hx), H). apply rtl. now exists x. 
241	Qed.
242	
243	(* s >=u ~s \/ s >= t <=> s >>a x >= t *)  
244	Theorem bvashr_uge2 : forall (n : N), forall (s t : bitvector n),
245	  iff
246	    ((bv_uge s (bv_not s) = true) \/ (bv_uge s t = true))
247	    (exists (x : bitvector n), (bv_uge (bv_ashr_a s x) t = true)).
248	Proof.
249	  intros n s t. destruct s as (s, Hs). destruct t as (t, Ht).
250	    unfold bv_ult, bv_uge, bv_ule, bv_ashr, signed_min in *.
251	    cbn in *. pose proof (@bvashr_uge2 n s t Hs Ht). 
252	    destruct H as (ltr, rtl). split.
253	  + intros H. specialize (@ltr H). destruct ltr as (x, (Hx, ltr)).
254	    exists (@MkBitvector n x Hx). easy.
255	  + intros H. destruct H as ((x, Hx), H). apply rtl. now exists x. 
256	Qed.
257	
258	(*------------------------------------------------------------*)
259	
260	
261	
262	(*--------------------Logical left shift 2--------------------*)
263	(* (exists i, s << i = t) <=> (exists x, s << x = t) *)
264	Theorem bvshl_eq2 : forall (n : N), forall (s t : bitvector n), 
265	  iff
266	    (exists (i : nat), bv_eq (bv_shl s (nat2bv i n)) t = true)
267	    (exists (x : bitvector n), bv_eq (bv_shl s x) t = true).
268	Proof. intros.
269	        destruct s as (s, Hs).
270	        destruct t as (t, Ht).
271	        unfold bv_shl, nat2bv, bv_eq, bv in *. cbn in *.
272	        specialize (InvCond.bvshl_eq2 n s t Hs Ht); intros.
273	        split; intros.
274	        - destruct H as (H, Ha).
275	          rewrite Hs in H.
276	          destruct H0 as (i, H0).
277	          rewrite RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bv_eq_reflect in H0.
278	          assert (exists i, RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bv_shl s (RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.nat2bv i n) = t).
279	          { exists i. easy. }
280	          specialize (H H1).
281	          destruct H as (x, (Hx, p)).
282	          exists (@MkBitvector n x Hx).
283	          now rewrite RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bv_eq_reflect.
284	        - destruct H as (H, Ha).
285	          destruct H0 as ((x, Hx), H0).
286	          assert ((exists x : RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bitvector,
287	          RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.size x = n /\ RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bv_shl s x = t)).
288	          { exists x. rewrite RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bv_eq_reflect in H0.
289	            easy. }
290	          specialize (Ha H1).
291	          destruct Ha as (i, Hi).
292	          exists i.
293	          rewrite RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bv_eq_reflect.
294	          now rewrite Hs in Hi.
295	Qed.
296	
297	(*------------------------------------------------------------*)
298	
299	
300	(*--------------------Logical right shift 1--------------------*)
301	(* (t << s) >> s = t <=> (exists x, x >> s = t) *)
302	Theorem bvshr_eq : forall (n : N), forall (s t : bitvector n), 
303	  iff 
304	    (bv_eq (bv_shr (bv_shl t s) s) t = true)
305	    (exists (x : bitvector n), bv_eq (bv_shr x s) t = true).
306	Proof. intros.
307	        destruct s as (s, Hs).
308	        destruct t as (t, Ht).
309	        unfold bv_eq, bv_shr, bv_shl, bv in *. cbn in *.
310	        specialize (InvCond.bvshr_eq n s t Hs Ht); intros.
311	        destruct H as (H, Ha).
312	        split; intros.
313	        - rewrite RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bv_eq_reflect in H0.
314	          specialize (H H0).
315	          destruct H as (x, (Hx, p)).
316	          exists (@MkBitvector n x Hx).
317	          now rewrite RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bv_eq_reflect.
318	        - rewrite RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bv_eq_reflect.
319	          apply Ha.
320	          destruct H0 as ((x, Hx), H0).
321	          rewrite RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bv_eq_reflect in H0.
322	          exists x; easy.
323	Qed.
324	
325	
326	(* (t <u (~s >> s)) => (exists x, (x >> s) >u t) *)
327	Theorem bvshr_ugt_ltr : forall (n : N), forall (s t : bitvector n), 
328	    (bv_ult t (bv_shr (bv_not s) s) = true) -> 
329	    (exists (x : bitvector n), bv_ugt (bv_shr x s) t = true).
330	Proof. intros.
331	       destruct s as (s, Hs).
332	       destruct t as (t, Ht).
333	       unfold bv_ugt, bv_ult, bv_shr, bv in *. cbn in *.
334	       specialize (InvCond.bvshr_ugt_ltr n s t Hs Ht); intros.
335	       unfold RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bv_not, RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bits in *.
336	       rewrite RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bv_shr_eq in H, H0.
337	       specialize (H0 H).
338	       destruct H0 as (x, (Hx, p)).
339	       rewrite RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bv_shr_eq in p.
340	       exists (@MkBitvector n x Hx).
341	       now rewrite RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bv_shr_eq.
342	Qed.
343	
344	
345	(* (exists x, (x >> s) >u t) => (t <u (~s >> s)) *)
346	Theorem bvshr_ugt_rtl : forall (n : N), forall (s t : bitvector n), 
347	    (exists (x : bitvector n), bv_ugt (bv_shr x s) t = true) ->
348	    (bv_ult t (bv_shr (bv_not s) s) = true).
349	Proof. intros.
350	       destruct s as (s, Hs).
351	       destruct t as (t, Ht).
352	       unfold bv_ugt, bv_ult, bv_shr, bv in *. cbn in *.
353	       specialize (bvshr_ugt_rtl n s t Hs Ht); intros. apply H0.
354	       destruct H as ((x, Hx), H1). exists x; easy.
355	Qed.
356	
357	
358	(* (exists x, (x >> s) >u t) <=> (t <u (~s >> s)) *)
359	Theorem bvshr_ugt : forall (n : N), forall (s t : bitvector n), 
360	    iff
361	    (bv_ult t (bv_shr (bv_not s) s) = true)
362	    (exists (x : bitvector n), bv_ugt (bv_shr x s) t = true).
363	Proof. intros.
364	       split.
365	       - apply bvshr_ugt_ltr.
366	       - apply bvshr_ugt_rtl.
367	Qed.
368	
369	(*------------------------------------------------------------*)
370	
371	
372	(*--------------------Logical right shift 2--------------------*)
373	(* (exists x, s >> x = t) <=> (exists i, s >> i = t) *)
374	Theorem bvshr_eq2 : forall (n : N), forall (s t : bitvector n), 
375	  iff 
376	    (exists (i : nat), bv_eq (bv_shr s (nat2bv i n)) t = true)
377	    (exists (x : bitvector n), bv_eq (bv_shr s x) t = true).
378	Proof. intros.
379	        destruct s as (s, Hs).
380	        destruct t as (t, Ht).
381	        unfold bv_eq, bv_shr, nat2bv, bv in *. cbn in *.
382	        specialize (bvshr_eq2 n s t Hs Ht); intros.
383	        destruct H as (Ha, H).
384	        split;intros.
385	        - destruct H0 as (i, H0).
386	          rewrite RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bv_eq_reflect in H0.
387	          assert (exists i, RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bv_shr s (RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.nat2bv i n) = t).
388	          { exists i. easy. }
389	          rewrite <- Hs in H1.
390	          specialize (Ha H1).
391	          destruct Ha as (x, (Hx, p)).
392	          exists (@MkBitvector n x Hx).
393	          now rewrite RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bv_eq_reflect.
394	        - destruct H0 as ((x, Hx), p).
395	          rewrite RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bv_eq_reflect in p.
396	          assert ((exists x : RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bitvector, 
397	              RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.size x = n /\ 
398	              RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bv_shr s x = t)).
399	          { exists x. easy. }
400	          specialize (H H0).
401	          destruct H as (i, H).
402	          exists i. 
403	          now rewrite RAWBITVECTOR_LIST.bv_eq_reflect, <- Hs.
404	Qed.
405	
406	(*------------------------------------------------------------*)
407	
408	
409	(*--------------------Arithmetic right shift 1--------------------*)
410	Theorem bvashr_eq : forall (n : N), forall (s t : bitvector n),
